CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for apps maintained by [hk21x](https://github.com/hk21x).
**decide** — Swipe. Decide. Watch. A self-hosted swipe-to-match film picker for your Plex library: friends swipe the same small deck, unanimous right-swipes become matches, a Final Round crowns tonight's film, and ticket stubs remember your movie nights.
Support and issues: https://github.com/hk21x/decide/issues
